headline: Saudi Aramco Third-Quarter Net Profit Surges 34.6 Percent
summary: Saudi Aramco reported a 34.6 percent surge in third-quarter net profit amid rising crude prices and attacks on the kingdom's energy infrastructure.
why: Saudi Aramco is the state-owned national oil company of Saudi Arabia and one of the world's largest crude producers, making its financials a key bellwether for global energy markets.

impacts.name: Saudi Aramco
impacts.why: A strong profit surge generally acts as a positive fundamental catalyst for the company's equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The 34.6 percent net profit jump significantly exceeds typical quarterly earnings volatility, boosting investor sentiment for the energy major.
